items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: Adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points), disability (MD -0.7 points), or circulating PGE2 concentrations compared with sham PBMT plus MCE at 6 weeks and throughout 12-month follow-up in 148 adults with chronic non-specific low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量 RCT 显示，对于慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中额外加入光生物调节疗法（HILT）并不能带来具有临床意义的额外改善，无论是短期还是长达 12 个月的随访。这进一步巩固了主动运动干预作为核心的地位，提醒你避免过度依赖被动物理因子。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛患者：光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练辅助手段效果甚微：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 148 名慢性非特异性腰痛患者的随机对照试验显示，在 6 周时，相比于安慰剂加运动控制训练，额外加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）未能显著改善疼痛强度（平均差 -0.4 分）、残疾（平均差 -0.7 分）或循环前列腺素 E2 浓度，且 12 个月随访期内差异也微乎其微。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT demonstrates that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise (MCE) provides no clinically important additional improvements for chronic non-specific low back pain, neither short-term nor at 12-month follow-up. This reinforces the primacy of active exercise interventions and cautions against over-reliance on passive modalities.
items.limitation: 研究未详细报告运动控制训练的具体内容与强度，可能影响结果的可推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific content and intensity of the motor control exercise, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Association Between Early Postoperative Limb Symmetry Index Scores and 2-Year Patient-Reported Outcomes After Quadriceps Tendon Autograft ACL Reconstruction.
items.summary: In 100 patients after quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction, 3-month isometric quadriceps LSI strongly predicted 2-year IKDC scores (β = 3.9, Adj R² = 0.36), while 9-month fast quadriceps LSI strongly predicted both Lysholm and IKDC scores (β = 3.9-4.7, Adj R² = 0.34-0.35).
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提供了四头肌腱自体移植物 ACL 重建术后 LSI 分数与长期患者报告结果之间关联的强有力证据。在指导康复进程和重返运动决策时，你可以将早期（3 个月）等长四头肌 LSI 以及 9 个月等速四头肌 LSI 作为预测 2 年 IKDC 和 Lysholm 评分的重要指标。
items.titleZh: 股四头肌腱自体移植物 ACL 重建术后早期肢体对称性指数与 2 年患者报告结果的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名股四头肌腱自体移植物 ACL 重建术后患者的研究显示，3 个月时的等长四头肌肢体对称性指数（LSI）强烈预测了 2 年国际膝关节文献委员会（IKDC）评分（β = 3.9，调整后 R² = 0.36），而 9 个月时的快速四头肌 LSI 则强烈预测了 Lysholm 和 IKDC 评分（β = 3.9-4.7，调整后 R² = 0.34-0.35）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study provides strong evidence for the association between early postoperative LSI scores and 2-year patient-reported outcomes after quadriceps tendon autograft ACL reconstruction. When guiding rehabilitation and return-to-sport decisions, you can use early (3-month) isometric quadriceps LSI and 9-month isokinetic quadriceps LSI as important predictors for 2-year IKDC and Lysholm scores.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列设计，证据等级为 4，无法建立因果关系，结果可能受到混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: This study is a case series design with level 4 evidence, which cannot establish causality and results may be affected by confounding factors.
items.journal: The American journal of sports medicine

items.title: Post burn Cubital Tunnel Syndrome Electrophysiological and Functional Responses to High intensity Laser Therapy versus Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: In 75 patients with post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, both HILT+UNGE and ESWT+UNGE improved nerve conduction and upper-limb function more than UNGE alone. HILT resulted in significantly greater improvements than ESWT across all electrophysiological outcomes and DASH scores, with benefits maintained at 12-week follow-up.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，对于烧伤后肘管综合征，结合高强度激光疗法（HILT）或体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）的尺神经滑动练习比单独滑动练习更有效，且 HILT 在神经电生理和功能结局上优于 ESWT。你可以考虑将 HILT 作为烧伤后 CuTS 患者的有效治疗选择，尤其是在电生理改善方面。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后肘管综合征：高强度激光疗法与体外冲击波疗法对电生理和功能反应的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 75 名烧伤后肘管综合征患者的随机对照试验显示，高强度激光疗法（HILT）加尺神经滑动练习（UNGE）和体外冲击波疗法（ESWT）加 UNGE 均比单独 UNGE 更能改善神经传导和上肢功能。HILT 在所有电生理指标和 DASH 评分上均优于 ESWT，且效果在 12 周随访时保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial indicates that, for post-burn cubital tunnel syndrome, ulnar nerve gliding exercises combined with either high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) or extracorporeal shock wave therapy (ESWT) are more effective than gliding exercises alone, with HILT being superior to ESWT in electrophysiological and functional outcomes. You may consider HILT as an effective treatment option for post-burn CuTS patients, especially for electrophysiological improvements.
items.limitation: 随访期相对较短（12 周），长期效果尚需更多研究确认。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up period is relatively short (12 weeks), and long-term effects require further confirmation.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: "It's a black box": Physiotherapists' perspectives on sensorimotor control and the use of technology in this context to improve rehabilitation following ACL injury.
items.summary: A qualitative study with 22 physiotherapists found interest in technology for sensorimotor assessment and rehabilitation after ACL injury, but implementation was limited by uncertainty regarding the clinical value of sensorimotor outcomes, highlighting the need for clearer evidence of clinical benefits and integration with clinical reasoning.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了物理治疗师在 ACL 损伤康复中对传感器运动控制技术的需求和顾虑。它证实了你作为临床医生对客观评估运动质量和技术融入临床工作流程的普遍渴望，也反映了技术临床价值不确定性带来的挑战。
items.titleZh: “这是一个黑箱”：物理治疗师对传感器运动控制的看法及技术在 ACL 损伤康复中应用
items.summaryZh: 一项对 22 名物理治疗师的定性研究发现，他们对 ACL 损伤后传感器运动控制的评估和康复技术感兴趣，但由于传感器运动控制结果的临床价值存在不确定性，其应用受到限制，这凸显了技术需要更明确的临床益处和与临床推理的整合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals physical therapists' needs and concerns regarding sensorimotor control technology in ACL injury rehabilitation. It confirms your common desire as a clinician for objective assessment of movement quality and technology integration into clinical workflows, and also reflects the challenges posed by uncertainty regarding the clinical value of technology.
items.limitation: 定性研究结果的普遍性可能有限，且受访者自我报告的偏倚无法完全排除。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of qualitative research findings may be limited, and self-report bias from participants cannot be fully excluded.

items.title: Fall prevention interventions among older adults in low-and middle-income countries (LMICs): an integrative review.
items.summary: An integrative review of 14 studies from seven low- and middle-income countries found that multifactorial interventions, exercise-based programs, and home safety modifications may reduce fall incidence, fall risk, and fear of falling among older adults, although evidence on contextual adaptation and scalability remains limited.
items.curatedReason: 这项综合性综述指出，在低收入和中等收入国家，运动、多因素干预和家庭安全改造可有效降低老年人跌倒风险。它支持你将力量、平衡和环境风险评估纳入跌倒预防项目，但也要留意将高收入国家经验本土化的挑战。
items.titleZh: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）老年人跌倒预防干预措施：一项综合性综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对七个低收入和中等收入国家的 14 项研究进行的综合性综述发现，多因素干预、运动项目和家庭安全改造可能降低老年人的跌倒发生率、跌倒风险和跌倒恐惧，但关于其背景适应性和可扩展性的证据仍然有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This integrative review indicates that exercise, multifactorial interventions, and home safety modifications can effectively reduce fall risk among older adults in low- and middle-income countries. It supports your inclusion of strength, balance, and environmental risk assessments in fall prevention programs, but also alerts you to the challenges of localizing high-income country experiences.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究数量有限，且干预措施和结果测量的异质性较高，可能影响结论的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies and high heterogeneity in interventions and outcome measures may affect the robustness of the conclusions.

items.title: Development of a Communication Characteristics Module for Autistic Adults and the Creation of a Communication Profile Variable
items.summary: The AASPIRE Outcomes Project developed a 10-item Communication Characteristics module and a five-level Communication Profile variable for autistic adults. Tested with 844 adults, the module showed high completion feasibility and strong construct validity, while the profile variable demonstrated strong construct validity and substantial test-retest reliability (kappa = 0.69).
items.curatedReason: 这份预印本提出了一个量化自闭症成人沟通特征的模块和沟通档案变量，对于理解沟通多样性、优化研究分组和干预策略具有潜在价值。它提示你未来可以利用这类工具更精细地评估和支持自闭症患者的康复需求。
items.titleZh: 自闭症成人沟通特征模块的开发及沟通档案变量的创建
items.summaryZh: AASPIRE 成果项目开发了一个 10 项沟通特征模块和五级沟通档案变量，用于描述自闭症成人的沟通。在对 844 名成人进行测试后，该模块表现出高完成可行性和强大的结构效度，而沟通档案变量则显示出强大的结构效度及显著的重测信度（kappa = 0.69）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preprint proposes a module and communication profile variable for quantifying communication characteristics in autistic adults, with potential value for understanding communication diversity, optimizing research stratification, and intervention strategies. It suggests that you could utilize such tools in the future to more precisely assess and support the rehabilitation needs of autistic individuals.
items.limitation: 本研究为预印本，尚未经过同行评审，且为自愿报告形式，可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study is a preprint and has not yet undergone peer review; being self-reported, it may have reporting bias.

items.title: The effect of functional inspiratory muscle training on diaphragm function and core stabilisation in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=40) found that a 10-week multicomponent functional inspiratory muscle training (F-IMT) program significantly improved diaphragm thickness (adjusted difference, 2.434 mm; 95% CI, 1.714 to 3.261; P < .001) and mobility, reduced pain, and increased respiratory muscle strength and core endurance in patients with chronic non-specific low back pain, compared to thoracic expansion exercises.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性非特异性腰痛患者，功能性吸气肌训练（F-IMT）值得纳入康复方案。这项 RCT 证明，一个 10 周的多组分 F-IMT 计划能显著改善患者的膈肌功能、核心耐力，并减轻疼痛。
items.titleZh: 功能性吸气肌训练对慢性非特异性腰痛患者膈肌功能和核心稳定的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=40）发现，与胸廓扩张运动相比，为期 10 周的多组分功能性吸气肌训练（F-IMT）方案显著改善了慢性非特异性腰痛患者的膈肌厚度（调整后差异 2.434 毫米；95% CI 1.714 至 3.261；P < .001）和活动度，并减轻了疼痛，增强了呼吸肌力量和核心耐力。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with chronic non-specific low back pain, functional inspiratory muscle training (F-IMT) should be considered in rehabilitation programs. This RCT demonstrates that a 10-week multicomponent F-IMT program significantly improves diaphragm function, core endurance, and reduces pain.
items.limitation: 这项研究仅使用了膈肌厚度作为主要结局指标，可能需要更多与临床功能直接相关的结局来进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily used diaphragm thickness as the main outcome, and further validation with more clinically relevant functional outcomes may be needed.

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: A scoping review of 80 randomized controlled trials identified 65 continuity of care interventions for stroke patients (PwS) and/or their caregivers. Most interventions focused on PwS only and addressed transitions from acute inpatient management to home care, with an average of two of three continuity of care dimensions and two of four family-centered care components addressed.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述发现中风患者的连续性护理干预多集中在急性期到居家护理的过渡，且常常只关注患者。你需要在制定干预方案时，更多地将照护者纳入进来，并关注全病程的过渡需求。
items.titleZh: 中风患者及其照护者的连续性护理干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 80 项随机对照试验进行的范围综述，识别了 65 项针对中风患者和/或其照护者的连续性护理干预。大多数干预措施仅关注中风患者，并侧重于从急性住院管理到居家护理的过渡，平均仅涵盖连续性护理的维度和以家庭为中心护理的组成部分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review found that continuity of care interventions for stroke patients often focus only on the patient and the transition from acute to home care. When designing interventions, you should include caregivers more actively and address transitions across the entire continuum of care.
items.limitation: 该综述仅限于RCT研究，可能未能涵盖其他类型研究中提出的有效干预措施。
items.limitationEn: This review was limited to RCTs, potentially excluding effective interventions discussed in other study designs.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study (N=20 per phase) found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) program for COPD patients was technically and clinically feasible. Device data transmission showed ≥99% clinical agreement, 95% of participants completed the 8-week program with high satisfaction (CSQ-8 median 30), and endurance time increased (median 171.00 seconds, 95% CI 17.00 to 725.00).
items.curatedReason: 这项初步的二期可行性研究显示，远程肺康复（HBPR）在 COPD 患者中技术和临床上均可行，且患者满意度高。你可以考虑将此模式作为未来患者管理的备选项，但还需等待大规模 RCT 证实其临床疗效。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺病患者肺部远程康复模型的技术与临床可行性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段可行性研究（每阶段 20 名受试者）发现，针对慢阻肺患者的居家肺部远程康复（HBPR）项目在技术和临床上均可行。设备数据传输临床一致性达 99% 以上，95% 的受试者完成了 8 周项目，满意度高（CSQ-8 中位数 30），且耐力时间有所增加（中位数 171.00 秒，95% CI 17.00 至 725.00）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary Phase 2 feasibility study indicates that telerehabilitation for COPD patients (HBPR) is technically and clinically feasible, with high patient satisfaction. You can consider this model for future patient management, but large-scale RCTs are needed to confirm its clinical efficacy.
items.limitation: 这项单中心的可行性研究样本量较小，且缺乏对照组，无法确证临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This single-center feasibility study had a small sample size and lacked a control group, preventing definitive conclusions on clinical efficacy.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Does prehabilitation with exercise improve clinical outcomes of arthroscopic modified Broström procedure in patients with chronic lateral ankle instability: a prospective cohort study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (N=276) found that a 4-week exercise-based prehabilitation program before arthroscopic modified Broström procedure for chronic lateral ankle instability was associated with significantly higher total FAOS scores at 2 years (92.4 vs. 80.0), better functional recovery, and faster return to sports compared to standard care, with benefits maintained at 24 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究提示，对于慢性外踝不稳行 Broström 手术的患者，术前康复能带来更好的患者报告结局和更快的运动回归。虽然不是随机对照研究，但你可以在临床中将其作为优化术后恢复的辅助策略，同时继续关注相关 RCT 证据。
items.titleZh: 运动康复预训练能否改善慢性外踝不稳患者关节镜改良 Broström 手术的临床结局：一项前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（N=276）发现，针对慢性外踝不稳患者在关节镜改良 Broström 手术前进行为期 4 周的运动预康复计划，与标准护理相比，两年时总 FAOS 评分显著更高（92.4 对 80.0），功能恢复更佳，并能更快重返运动，且益处在 24 个月时仍保持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study suggests that prehabilitation improves patient-reported outcomes and accelerates return to sport for patients undergoing the Broström procedure for chronic lateral ankle instability. While not an RCT, you can consider this as an adjunct strategy to optimize postoperative recovery, while staying informed on future RCT evidence.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性队列研究，非随机化设计可能存在选择偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective cohort study, and its non-randomized design may introduce selection bias.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Here are the Speech Language Therapy Coding Changes Going Into Effect on January 1, 2027
items.summary: The CPT Editorial Panel is replacing speech-language therapy code 92507 with ten new, more specific codes effective January 1, 2027. These new codes are structured to cover fluency disorders, speech sound production disorders, language comprehension and expression disorders, combined speech sound production and language disorders, and voice/upper airway dysfunction/resonance disorders.
items.curatedReason: 这项新闻介绍了言语治疗的 CPT 编码在 2027 年 1 月 1 日的修订。这些变化主要影响言语治疗师，物理治疗师只需了解即可，与你的直接执业影响不大。
items.titleZh: 言语治疗编码变更将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效
items.summaryZh: CPT 编辑委员会决定自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，用十个新的、更具体的编码取代言语治疗编码 92507。这些新编码旨在涵盖流利性障碍、言语发音障碍、语言理解和表达障碍、言语发音与语言综合障碍以及发音/上呼吸道功能障碍/共鸣障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This news covers the CPT coding revisions for speech-language therapy effective January 1, 2027. These changes primarily affect speech-language pathologists; physical therapists should be aware but are not directly impacted in their practice.

items.title: PTJ Author Interview: Severe Spinal Stenosis and Exercise-Based Rehabilitation
items.summary: An APTA podcast interview with Bahar Shahidi, PT, DPT, PhD, discusses her recent study showing that exercise-based rehabilitation yields similar improvements in patients with mild, moderate, or severe radiographic spinal stenosis. The discussion covers how imaging influences clinical decision-making and the specific benefits of exercise in this population.
items.curatedReason: 这项访谈强调，放射学影像显示的腰椎管狭窄严重程度并不影响患者对运动康复的反应。这意味着你不应该仅根据影像结果就排除运动疗法，即使是重度狭窄的患者也应优先考虑非手术康复。
items.titleZh: PTJ 作者访谈：重度脊柱管狭窄与运动康复
items.summaryZh: APTA 播客访谈了物理治疗博士 Bahar Shahidi，讨论了她最近的研究，该研究发现运动康复在影像学显示轻度、中度或重度脊柱管狭窄的患者中能带来同等幅度的改善。访谈内容包括影像学如何影响临床决策以及运动康复在此类人群中的特定益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This interview highlights that radiographic severity of lumbar spinal stenosis does not impact responsiveness to exercise-based rehabilitation. This means you should not rule out exercise therapy based solely on imaging results; even patients with severe stenosis should be prioritized for non-surgical rehabilitation.

items.title: Recovery strategies, training volume, and performance in Japanese recreational marathon runners: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional questionnaire survey (N=5,204) of Japanese recreational marathon runners found bathing (86.5%), stretching (85.0%), hot spring use (66.7%), and massage (47.0%) were the most common recovery strategies. Active recovery, contrast baths, and acupuncture/moxibustion showed modest associations with shorter personal best marathon times and higher monthly training volume.
items.curatedReason: 别轻易推荐跑者做主动恢复、冷热交替浴或针灸来提高成绩，这项针对 5,204 名日本跑者的横断面调查只发现它们与更短的马拉松最好成绩和更高的月训练量有微弱关联。不过，你可以了解患者最常用的恢复策略是洗浴（86.5%）、拉伸（85.0%）、温泉（66.7%）和按摩（47.0%）。
items.titleZh: 日本休闲马拉松跑者的恢复策略、训练量与表现：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对日本休闲马拉松跑者进行的横断面问卷调查（N=5,204）发现，洗浴（86.5%）、拉伸（85.0%）、温泉（66.7%）和按摩（47.0%）是最常见的恢复策略。主动恢复、冷热交替浴以及针灸/艾灸与更短的个人最好马拉松成绩和更高的月训练量存在适度关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Do not readily recommend active recovery, contrast baths, or acupuncture to runners for performance enhancement; this cross-sectional survey of 5,204 Japanese runners only found modest associations with shorter marathon personal best times and higher monthly training volume. However, you should note that patients most commonly use bathing (86.5%), stretching (85.0%), hot springs (66.7%), and massage (47.0%) as recovery strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面描述性研究，无法建立因果关系，且回复率较低（3.0%）可能限制了结果的代表性。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional descriptive study, unable to establish causality, and a low response rate (3.0%) may limit the representativeness of the findings.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Value-Based Care: APTA Resources to Help You Prepare
items.summary: APTA has compiled and updated resources to help physical therapists understand and prepare for the shift towards value-based care models, which are becoming more prominent in healthcare payment and delivery. These resources address how different payment models work, necessary practice capabilities, and how to evaluate agreements.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了系列资源以帮助物理治疗师应对日益增长的价值医疗模式。这提示你需要了解并开始准备应对这种支付和交付模式的变化，以确保你的实践能有效展示 PT 服务的价值。
items.titleZh: 价值医疗：APTA 资源助您做好准备
items.summaryZh: APTA 汇编并更新了资源，旨在帮助物理治疗师理解并为向价值医疗模式的转变做好准备，该模式在医疗支付和交付中日益突出。这些资源涵盖了不同支付模式的运作方式、实践所需能力以及如何评估协议等问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released resources to help physical therapists navigate the growing value-based care model. This indicates you need to understand and prepare for changes in this payment and delivery model to ensure your practice can effectively demonstrate the value of PT services.

items.title: Keeping Pace in a Changing Healthcare Landscape
items.summary: This article discusses the need for rehab therapy practices to adapt to a changing healthcare landscape, addressing patient demands for convenience, provider struggles with documentation, billing team needs for efficient claims management, and owners' need for operational insights. It emphasizes a new approach to meet the expectations of patients, payers, and providers amidst increasing competition and tighter economics.
items.curatedReason: 这篇行业评论文章指出，康复治疗实践需要适应不断变化的患者期望、提供者需求和支付方要求。这提醒你在规划实践运营时，需关注市场竞争、患者便利性、提供者文档负担和账单管理效率，以保持竞争力。
items.titleZh: 在不断变化的医疗格局中保持领先
items.summaryZh: 本文探讨了康复治疗实践需适应不断变化的医疗格局，以应对患者对便利性的需求、提供者在文档方面的困境、计费团队对高效索赔管理的需求以及所有者对运营洞察的需求。文章强调了一种新方法，以在日益激烈的竞争和更紧张的经济环境下满足患者、支付方和提供者的期望。
items.curatedReasonEn: This industry commentary highlights that rehab therapy practices need to adapt to evolving patient expectations, provider needs, and payer demands. This reminds you that when planning practice operations, you need to focus on market competition, patient convenience, provider documentation burden, and billing management efficiency to stay competitive.

items.title: Upright Participation for Learners with Physical Disabilities: A Pilot Randomized Crossover Effectiveness-Implementation Trial of Robot-assisted Walking in Schools
items.summary: A pilot randomized crossover trial (n=8) found robot-assisted walking in schools feasible, with device use ranging 48-96 minutes/week. It showed potential effectiveness for children with physical disabilities, with a mean COPM change of 3.56 (SD 1.07) for intervention vs 2.11 (SD 2.41) for control (dz=0.74).
items.curatedReason: 机器人辅助步行在学校环境中实施的可行性得到了初步验证，且对提高有肢体残疾儿童的参与度有积极潜力。你可以期待未来更明确的随机对照试验结果。
items.titleZh: 肢体残疾学生在校直立参与：机器人辅助步行在学校的试点随机交叉效应-实施试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机交叉试验（n=8）评估了在学校实施机器人辅助步行的可行性与潜在效果。结果显示，设备周使用时间为48-96分钟，对肢体残疾儿童的参与度有积极潜力（COPM平均变化：干预组3.56，对照组2.11；dz=0.74）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study provides preliminary evidence for the feasibility of robot-assisted walking in schools and its potential to increase participation for children with physical disabilities. Expect definitive RCT results in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本（8名儿童）试点随机交叉试验，主要评估实施策略和程序，而非最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This was a small-sample (8 children) pilot randomized crossover trial primarily evaluating implementation strategies and procedures, not definitive efficacy.

items.title: CMS News: Trump Administration Announces $32 Million to Recruit Rural Doctors, Train Healthcare Workers and Expand Emergency Mental Healthcare Across Mississippi
items.summary: The Trump administration announced a $32 million allocation for Mississippi to recruit rural doctors, train healthcare workers, and expand emergency mental healthcare services.
items.curatedReason: 特朗普政府宣布为密西西比州拨款，用于农村医生招聘、医疗工作者培训和紧急精神卫生保健。这可能间接影响该地区物理治疗师的职业环境，因为医疗人力资源的整体提升会带来系统性变化。

items.summaryZh: 特朗普政府宣布将向密西西比州拨款，以支持农村医生招聘、医疗工作者培训和扩大紧急精神卫生保健服务。
